9992151: Shutein went mad after drinking the potion of wisdom. He's determined to complete his invention of a war machine. Watch out for the flames that the war machine emits from its right arm!
9992152: Big Hand loves eating. His large belly is his weapon. Make sure to stop and wait when he's sticking out his big belly.
9992153: Zarkus is a skilled swordsman. He's able to block any attack with his shield and immediately follow up with his counterattack. Be careful when he has his shield out.
9992154: Medelim is a scaredy-cat. He died searching for the ancient remains but the power of the remains revived him. He's always thinking about running away, so drop him to the ground by throwing your shield when he goes up in the sky.
9992155: Elvacil is an arrogant empress who loves her pet to death. Try to block her attacks with a perfect guard and you'll be able to see her lose her calm.
9992156: Satyr is the imp of hell who's violent and strong, unlike most imps. His fire whip is like lightning and he can start a shower of fire balls from the sky. Always make sure to avoid his whips.
9992157: Anubis is cursed and his goal is to share his pain with his enemies. Use your allies to get out as quickly as you can when he casts his stone coffin.
9992158: Don't laugh at Skull Fish because he's the scariest monster you'll ever see when he's mad. Ordinary swords aren't strong enough to inflict the slightest damage on him. Try to stun him and attack with attribute skills.
9992159: Higenmur is the ghost of the sea still searching for the hidden treasures with his men. His fast gunshots should be feared but the ghost cannon is the worst. Keep your eyes on Higenmur's fingertips.
9992160: Carlos the 3rd rules the kingdom even after death. He remains the leader of his dead soldiers. Watch out for the ghost knights that never seem to stop charging.
9992161: The greedy Fire Dragon Iz burns anything that gets close to his nest. Keep your eyes open for the fire breath that he emits from time to time.
9992162: She is the giant spider queen. She was the protector of the remains but she was cursed after the remains were stolen, and was subsequently turned into a spider. Watch out for the spiders that come to aid the queen.
9992163: A giant guardian created by an unknown power. His power is strong enough to destroy dragons. Be extra careful when his mouth is open, because a bright light will shine to demolish everything.
9992164: Want to meet the grim reaper? Your life will be shortened just for seeing him, and you'll meet your death eventually.
9992165: The working bees always obey their queen. They'll even abandon their honey to fight against their enemies, because they know that the honey can be used to slow them down.
9992166: Have you ever seen a monster rolled up in a dark, eerie place? You won't be able to move once your eyes meet the eyes of the monster. Taking a recovery ally is a must if you want to survive the poison of the monster.
9992167: Known as twins, they were originally noble offspring. They excelled at swordsmanship, and became famous knights within the Kingdom. However, they became possessed by something unknown, which drove them crazy. Be careful of their switching attacks.
9992168: All bees follow the order of none other besides their queen. If the queen bee moves, the whole swarm moves as well. Lezzeta is a very greedy and ambitious queen bee. She is attempting to create a bee empire because she simply can't be satisfied with just one. Beware of bees that follow her. They will neutralize your allies.
9992169: Garlentis, the Commander of Hell. He is one of the most favored demons by Rak'mark, the lord of hell himself. His violent personality is infamous for annihilating all enemies and allies when he gets angry. Facing him would mean certain death. If you happen to find yourself opposing him, give it everything you've got and try to end it as quickly as possible.
